verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe budget/rate limits on API keys, model catalog with org/workspace-level governance, logs with metadata, and centralized tracking across providers/models/keys via virtual keys — directly supporting per-model/key/team/user spend tracking across providers in one place. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification (e.g., third-party review or screenshot) confirming the per-team/per-user breakdown works in practice, and no explicit dashboard example showing a combined view across all these dimensions simultaneously.
